cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At our mystery dinner, we both named the gardener. I've put my answer above yours on the board. You can see how your old tutor got there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We followed the same muddy footprint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, you've learned to spot it. Now we compare who reached the conclusion first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But I wrote it first. That's why I always made you put your answer down before discussing it. A useful lesson; mine's the top line.
